youtube_description:
Rim Trail (105) Cloudcroft NM Pt1

This is the beginning of the rim trail (Trail 105) in the Lincoln National Forest in New Mexico near Cloudcroft NM.   The trail is a total of 31 miles.   I was out with a couple of new riders and we hit a few obstacles that slowed us down as well as a finicky XR650R.  But the trail is really nice and has some challenging spots.
